signals.name: Intel Corporation
signals.label: Congress+13F+Gov-stake overlap
signals.detail: Pelosi (spouse) disclosed a ~$500K-$1M INTC buy plus long-dated calls in late July; McCaul separately disclosed a ~$500K INTC buy in his September omnibus filing. 27 members of Congress have collectively disclosed ~100 INTC trades (~$4.8M bought) this cycle. Hedge fund ownership jumped to 138 funds holding ~$28.2B by Q2 2026-end (from 112 funds/$8.7B prior quarter), and the U.S. government itself holds a 9.9% equity stake via CHIPS Act grant conversions.
signals.takeaway: Intel is one of the few names where congressional buying, a surge in institutional 13F ownership, and direct federal government equity ownership are all pointing the same direction simultaneously.

signals.name: Palantir Technologies
signals.label: Congress+13F crosscurrents
signals.detail: Cisneros (D-CA, Armed Services) disclosed a new PLTR buy in early September. Institutionally, PLTR remains widely held (31 of 73 sampled funds long) even as aggregate 13F share counts fell ~9.8% quarter-over-quarter. Simultaneously, Michael Burry's post-Scion newsletter (Cassandra Unchained) disclosed a fresh short/put position against Palantir in August.
signals.takeaway: Palantir is drawing attention from both congressional buyers and a prominent bearish investor at the same time, making it a genuine consensus-split name rather than one-directional conviction.

signals.name: Microsoft Corporation
signals.label: Congress crossfire
signals.detail: Gottheimer disclosed a ~$1.5M MSFT buy (Aug 14) and Cisneros disclosed a smaller MSFT buy in the same window, while Kevin Hern disclosed an MSFT sell (Aug 21) -- three different members trading the same mega-cap in opposite directions within weeks of each other.
signals.takeaway: Congressional activity on Microsoft is currently split rather than consensus, which is itself a notable pattern worth flagging alongside single-direction "signals."

signals.name: NVIDIA Corporation
signals.label: Congress sell + bear 13F + Reddit AI basket
signals.detail: Sen. Whitehouse disclosed an NVDA sale (Aug 13). Michael Burry's newsletter separately disclosed an expanded short position against NVDA in August. On the retail side, NVDA continues to appear in Reddit/AltIndex 'bullish AI basket' mentions alongside Meta and Micron, and an NVDA-IonQ partnership announcement (Sept 23) renewed retail chatter.
signals.takeaway: NVIDIA is simultaneously seeing a congressional exit, a known bear's short position, and continued heavy retail/AI-basket attention -- a genuinely mixed-signal mega-cap right now.

signals.name: IonQ Inc.
signals.label: Reddit momentum
signals.detail: IonQ mentions on r/wallstreetbets surged roughly 2,300% in 24 hours per AltIndex tracking, driven by the company's Sept 23 announcement of an end-to-end real-time quantum error-correction decoder plus a highlighted Nvidia partnership; quantum peers RGTI, QBTS and INFQ moved in sympathy.
signals.takeaway: IonQ's retail-momentum spike is tied to a concrete news catalyst (the error-correction breakthrough) rather than pure speculation, though the burn-rate risk flagged by analysts remains a separate consideration.

signals.name: Meta Platforms
signals.label: Reddit momentum leader
signals.detail: META was the #1 most-mentioned ticker on r/wallstreetbets in the last 24 hours (296 mentions, +100% trend vs. prior period) per ApeWisdom, ahead of SPY, MU, AMD and NBIS.
signals.takeaway: Meta has displaced the usual mega-cap chatter leaders on WSB this week, worth watching for follow-through given the scale of the mention spike.

signals.name: Bloom Energy Corporation

Separately, Quiver Quantitative's 'Congress Buys' strategy shows an outsized ~50% portfolio weighting in BE, with 8 congressional purchases over the past year totaling at least $3.0M.
signals.takeaway: Bloom Energy has become one of the more concentrated congressional-buying names in the AI-power theme, anchored by a marquee first-time buyer.
